_metadata.revision_status: Corrected working copy, unreleased; numerical scores and ranking order preserved.
_metadata.composite_definition: Mean of two separately min-max-normalized sets of nine group means: archived auto_weighted and GPT-judge mean; 45 Claude-generated documents per group. Claude-judge scores are not part of this composite.
_metadata.size_unit: Thousands of cl100k_base tokens (1 k-token = 1000 tokens), counting archived configuration text only.
_metadata.size_basis: Fixed configuration text for A/B/C/E; mean across all 15 archived task-specific configurations for F/G/H2/H3/H4, not only the three GPT generation tasks.
_metadata.size_limitations: Excludes task messages, agent wrappers, tools and unarchived context. Historical Claude input logs are absent; values are not verified API input-token usage, cross-generator input equivalence, or minimum effective thresholds.
_metadata.legacy_labels: The original third-column values were byte-based size labels misidentified as tokens. They are retained below for provenance, not for quantitative token analysis.
_metadata.comparison_delta: comparisons[*].delta is the difference in GPT-judge means (a minus b), not a composite-score difference.
